extracted.name: Meatballs In Plum Sauce
extracted.description: #GoldenApron23. I found the recipe online and adapted it to make a quick appetizer.
ingredient_lines: Bag frozen precooked meatballs (need about 36 1" size meatballs)
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 350 degrees; if you want to use a crockpot skip steps 2 and 4 and place the browned meatballs in a 3qt. crockpot.
In a skillet brown the meatballs. Save the pan juice.
Place the browned meatballs in the baking dish.

In a small bowl, dissolve bouillon in water. Add flour into the pan drippings until blended; add the bouillon mixture, jam, and chili sauce. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1/2 minutes or until thickened. Pour over meatballs.
Cover baking dish and place in preheated oven for 20-30 minutes or until heated through and sauce is bubbly. If using a crockpot heat on low 2-3 hours or until meatballs are heated.
